info.name: deployserver operator API
info.description:
The operator-facing REST API for deployserver. All endpoints under `/api/v1` require a bearer OIDC ID token (obtain one with `deployctl auth login`); in dev mode (no OIDC configured) auth is open. Permissions are enforced per-endpoint via RBAC — the required permission is noted in each operation's description. This document is kept honest by a contract test that asserts the running routes and these paths are in exact correspondence.

Generated from the OpenAPI spec — do not edit by hand.
Set the `baseUrl` and `token` collection variables (or use the bundled environment).

request.description: Public (pre-auth). The UI and CLI call this to learn the issuer and client id for the login flow, and whether the server runs in dev mode.
Requires `machine.write`. Omitted fields are unchanged; an empty `default_profile_id` clears it.
Requires `deployment.create`. Site defaults to the machine's `attributes.site`.

item.name: Get a profile with its answer-file templates
Preview a profile's rendered answer file

request.description: Requires `profile.read`. Renders the stored template (or a provided draft body) with a synthetic machine context and reports whether the output is well-formed YAML — catching typos in the editor instead of on hardware.

item.name: Register a blob and get a presigned upload URL

request.description: Requires `image.write`. Upload the bytes to the returned URL (PUT), then link via image or driver-pack version.

item.name: Link an uploaded blob as a new image version

request.description: Requires `image.write`. Register the blob with POST /api/v1/blobs first.

item.name: Create a driver-pack version with match rules

query.description: Model name or machine type, e.g. 'X1 Carbon' or '20XW'

request.description: Requires `driverpack.read`. Searches Lenovo's published enterprise driver-pack catalog by model name or machine type. Empty query returns nothing.

Requires `driverpack.write`. The URL must be one returned by the search endpoint — the server only downloads addresses read from the vendor's own catalog. The pack is streamed into the blob store, sha256-verified against the catalog, and registered with dmi-product-prefix match rules for its machine types.

item.name: Install an image from the catalog
Get a job with its event trail

request.description: Requires `deployment.create`. Revokes the job's boot tokens.

item.name: Issue deployment codes for many machines

request.description: Requires `deployment.create`. Up to 100 machines; always 200 with per-machine results.

item.name: Flat CSV export of jobs in a window
Grant a role to a user
Revoke a role from a user

request.description: Requires `user.write`. Refused (409) if it would remove the last admin.
Requires `stick.write` or `*`. Returns config.json, the CA PEM, and the make-stick.sh command.
Requires `apitoken.read` or `*`. Returns the caller's own tokens (the secret is never included; revoked and expired tokens are listed with their `revoked_at` / `expires_at` set).

Requires `apitoken.write` or `*`. Mints a long-lived bearer token that authenticates as the calling user (inheriting exactly that user's permissions). The plaintext secret is returned **once** in this response and never again.
Requires `apitoken.write` or `*`. Revokes one of the caller's own tokens. Idempotent only in effect — a second revoke returns 404.
